dpp_intro.title: Digital Product Passport (DPP)
dpp_intro.description: The Digital Product Passport is an innovative system designed to increase transparency along the value chain of products. It will become mandatory for almost all products sold in the EU from 2024, providing comprehensive information on the origin, materials, environmental impact and disposal recommendations.

core_components.title: The Core Components of DPP
core_components.description: The DPP system includes unique product identifiers, compliance documents, and information about hazardous materials. User manuals, safety instructions, and product disposal guides are also important components of the system. These data improve supply chain management and regulatory compliance.

implementation.title: How is DPP Implemented?
implementation.description: The DPP system provides secure and transparent data sharing using blockchain technology and smart contracts. Easy access to product information is provided through QR codes or RFID tags.

legalDisclaimer.title: A LEGAL DISCLAIMER
legalDisclaimer.content: The explanations and information provided on this page are only general and high-level explanations and information on how to write your own document of a Privacy Policy. You should not rely on this article as legal advice or as recommendations regarding what you should actually do, because we cannot know in advance what are the specific privacy policies you wish to establish between your business and your customers and visitors. We recommend that you seek legal advice to help you understand and to assist you in the creation of your own Privacy Policy.

basics.title: PRIVACY POLICY - THE BASICS
basics.content: Having said that, a privacy policy is a statement that discloses some or all of the ways a website collects, uses, discloses, processes, and manages the data of its visitors and customers. It usually also includes a statement regarding the website's commitment to protecting its visitors' or customers' privacy, and an explanation about the different mechanisms the website is implementing in order to protect privacy.

jurisdiction.content: Different jurisdictions have different legal obligations of what must be included in a Privacy Policy. You are responsible to make sure you are following the relevant legislation to your activities and location.

inclusion.title: WHAT TO INCLUDE IN THE PRIVACY POLICY
inclusion.content: Generally speaking, a Privacy Policy often addresses these types of issues: the types of information the website is collecting and the manner in which it collects the data; an explanation about why is the website collecting these types of information; what are the website's practices on sharing the information with third parties; ways in which your visitors an customers can exercise their rights according to the relevant privacy legislation; the specific practices regarding minors' data collection; and much much more.

legalDisclaimer.title: A LEGAL DISCLAIMER
legalDisclaimer.content: The explanations and information provided on this page are only general and high-level explanations and information on how to write your own document of Terms & Conditions. You should not rely on this article as legal advice or as recommendations regarding what you should actually do, because we cannot know in advance what are the specific terms you wish to establish between your business and your customers and visitors. We recommend that you seek legal advice to help you understand and to assist you in the creation of your own Terms & Conditions.

basics.title: TERMS & CONDITIONS - THE BASICS
basics.content: Having said that, Terms and Conditions (T&C) are a set of legally binding terms defined by you, as the owner of this website. The T&C set forth the legal boundaries governing the activities of the website visitors, or your customers, while they visit or engage with this website. The T&C are meant to establish the legal relationship between the site visitors and you as the website owner.

specificity.content: T&C should be defined according to the specific needs and nature of each website. For example, a website offering products to customers in e-commerce transactions requires T&C that are different from the T&C of a website only providing information (like a blog, a landing page, and so on).

protection.content: T&C provide you as the website owner the ability to protect yourself from potential legal exposure, but this may differ from jurisdiction to jurisdiction, so make sure to receive local legal advice if you are trying to protect yourself from legal exposure.

inclusion.title: WHAT TO INCLUDE IN THE T&C DOCUMENT
inclusion.content: Generally speaking, T&C often address these types of issues: Who is allowed to use the website; the possible payment methods; a declaration that the website owner may change his or her offering in the future; the types of warranties the website owner gives his or her customers; a reference to issues of intellectual property or copyrights, where relevant; the website owner's right to suspend or cancel a member's account; and much much more.

manufacturers.heroDescription: Ensure compliance, certification & sustainable growth with UseSafe® solutions tailored for manufacturers and brand owners.
manufacturers.benefitsDescription: Across global markets, manufacturers and brand owners are entering a new era of accountability. Driven by the EU Green Deal, the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR), and rapidly evolving consumer expectations, sustainability is no longer a matter of choice—it is a fundamental business requirement. To remain competitive and compliant, companies must demonstrate full transparency across their value chains, verify product safety, and continuously improve environmental performance. UseSafe provides a comprehensive digital solution for achieving these objectives with precision and efficiency. The platform consolidates all material, chemical, and supplier data into a unified system, automating compliance validation and certification workflows in accordance with REACH, RoHS, ESPR, and other key regulations. Through advanced data management and real-time reporting, UseSafe minimizes administrative complexity, mitigates compliance risks, and ensures continuous alignment with international sustainability standards. Beyond regulatory compliance, UseSafe enables businesses to transform sustainability into measurable value. By leveraging verified product data, digital product passports, and transparent traceability tools, companies can strengthen brand integrity, enhance customer trust, and unlock new opportunities in sustainable innovation. With UseSafe, compliance becomes confidence—empowering manufacturers and brand owners to lead responsibly, build trust at scale, and shape a more sustainable future for their industries.

supplier.description: Connect every supplier in your value chain. UseSafe® helps manufacturers collect and verify supplier data, ensuring consistent standards across all components and materials. Real-time dashboards make it easy to track sustainability performance across global networks.

insights.title: Data-Driven Insights & Reporting
insights.description: Transform data into strategic advantage. With UseSafe®, companies gain actionable insights through automated sustainability reports, risk analysis, and performance dashboards—helping decision-makers align operations with ESG goals and future regulations.

ecommerce.heroDescription: Demonstrate compliance, strengthen consumer trust, and ensure sustainable growth with UseSafe® solutions for online sellers and distributors.
ecommerce.benefitsDescription: Consumers are demanding verified sustainability claims, regulators are introducing stricter product-data requirements, and marketplaces are enforcing higher standards for transparency and safety. For sellers and distributors, maintaining compliance while managing large and dynamic product portfolios has become a critical challenge. UseSafe provides an intelligent, end-to-end solution designed specifically for online sellers, distributors, and marketplace operators. By automating compliance checks, managing digital product data, and enabling Digital Product Passports (DPPs), UseSafe helps businesses ensure every listed product meets legal, environmental, and ethical standards. The platform integrates seamlessly with existing e-commerce systems and ERP tools, giving sellers complete visibility into product origins, material content, and certification status—without disrupting daily operations. Beyond regulatory compliance, UseSafe empowers e-commerce businesses to build trust and loyalty at scale. By offering verifiable product information and sustainability credentials, sellers can differentiate themselves in competitive marketplaces, reduce the risk of product delistings, and enhance customer confidence. UseSafe enables transparency that goes beyond marketing—transforming it into measurable credibility that drives long-term growth and responsible commerce.

compliance.title: Automated Compliance for Online Markets
compliance.description: Ensure every product you sell meets the latest environmental and safety regulations. UseSafe® automates compliance verification across large product catalogs—covering REACH, RoHS, ESPR, and marketplace-specific standards—so sellers can stay compliant without slowing down business.

centralized.title: Centralized Product Data Management
centralized.description: Unify all product, supplier, and certification data in one secure platform. UseSafe® eliminates fragmented spreadsheets and manual uploads by connecting directly with your ERP, PIM, or marketplace systems—ensuring your listings are always up to date, accurate, and compliant.

visibility.title: Supply Chain Visibility for Distributors
visibility.description: Track compliance and sustainability across your entire distribution network. UseSafe® enables distributors to monitor product flow, supplier certifications, and logistics data in real time—offering full visibility from manufacturer to end-user, ensuring consistent quality and integrity.

analytics.title: Performance Analytics & Reporting
analytics.description: Turn compliance and sustainability data into strategic insight. UseSafe's analytics dashboards deliver actionable intelligence on product performance, compliance risks, and sustainability metrics—empowering data-driven decisions that improve profitability and ESG sustainability performance.

dpp.title: Digital Product Passports (DPP)
dpp.description: Bring transparency and traceability to every product. UseSafe® automatically generates Digital Product Passports that make sustainability and safety information accessible to consumers and regulators through QR or NFC verification—helping you build trust and avoid greenwashing risks.

reputation.title: Enhanced Consumer Trust & Brand Reputation
reputation.description: Consumers are more informed than ever—credibility drives conversion. By providing verifiable data on product origin, materials, and sustainability claims, UseSafe® helps sellers earn long-term trust, reduce return rates, and strengthen brand reputation across marketplaces.

marketplaces.heroDescription: Ensure compliance, certification & sustainable growth with UseSafe® solutions tailored for manufacturers and brand owners.
marketplaces.benefitsDescription: Marketplaces and retailers operate in an environment where regulatory expectations, consumer scrutiny, and platform governance are tightening simultaneously. Under frameworks such as the EU Green Deal and the ESPR, transparency, product safety, and verifiable sustainability data are now baseline requirements for listing and selling products at scale. Ensuring that every item—across thousands of brands and sellers—meets these standards demands rigorous controls, high-quality data, and automated compliance. UseSafe provides a unified, enterprise-grade platform that standardizes product data, streamlines verification, and automates compliance checks across vast, fast-moving catalogs. From material and chemical composition to certifications and Digital Product Passports (DPPs), UseSafe consolidates critical information in one system—integrated with PIM/ERP and marketplace workflows—so teams can manage risk proactively while maintaining operational velocity. Beyond regulatory alignment, UseSafe turns transparency into commercial advantage. By enabling accurate, verifiable, and consumer-facing product information, retailers and marketplaces strengthen brand integrity, protect customers, reduce delistings and returns, and differentiate on trust. With UseSafe, governance becomes scalable, listings become reliable, and growth aligns with responsible retail.

dataQuality.title: Product Data Quality & Standardization
dataQuality.description: Eliminate fragmented, inconsistent product data. UseSafe® centralizes attributes, certifications, and documentation, enforcing taxonomy and schema rules across brands and sellers for cleaner, searchable listings.

listingCompliance.description: Standardize and automate compliance at listing time. UseSafe® validates product safety, sustainability, and regulatory conformity (e.g., REACH, RoHS, ESPR) before items go live—reducing delistings, penalties, and reputational risk.

dppScale.title: Digital Product Passports (DPP) at Scale
dppScale.description: Bring verifiable transparency to every SKU. UseSafe® generates and manages DPPs with QR/NFC access—making origin, materials, and sustainability claims easily verifiable for customers, regulators, and partners.

riskManagement.title: Seller & Supplier Risk Management
riskManagement.description: Know your sellers; trust your suppliers. UseSafe® collects and monitors supplier credentials, audit outcomes, and incident history—flagging gaps early and enabling data-driven onboarding and continuous oversight.

recall.title: Recall, Incident & Claims Response

esgInsights.title: ESG Insights & Executive Reporting
esgInsights.description: Turn compliance data into retail strategy. Dashboards track sustainability KPIs, seller performance, and risk trends—supporting disclosures and informing assortment, sourcing, and category decisions.

regulatory.heroDescription: Authorities and government agencies play a critical role in enforcing sustainability and product safety standards. UseSafe® provides transparent, standardized data to support effective oversight, regulatory compliance, and sustainable growth.
regulatory.benefitsDescription: Governments and regulatory authorities play a crucial role in shaping the global transition toward sustainability, product safety, and supply chain transparency. Yet, the rapid evolution of materials, markets, and technologies makes consistent enforcement and oversight increasingly complex. Ensuring compliance at scale requires not only legislation—but reliable data, traceable systems, and digital collaboration between regulators and industry. UseSafe supports regulatory bodies and government agencies by providing a unified digital infrastructure for monitoring product compliance, verifying sustainability claims, and analyzing market data in real time. Through interoperable databases, Digital Product Passports (DPPs), and analytics dashboards, UseSafe enables authorities to validate manufacturer and retailer data more efficiently, identify non-compliance risks early, and ensure consistent enforcement across borders. Beyond enforcement, UseSafe serves as a strategic enabler for evidence-based policymaking and sustainable innovation. By facilitating trusted data exchange between public institutions and private stakeholders, the platform helps governments improve transparency, strengthen consumer protection, and accelerate the circular economy. UseSafe empowers regulators to lead with data-driven governance—making sustainability measurable, traceable, and accountable.

consumers.heroDescription: Modern consumers expect transparency, authenticity, and sustainability. UseSafe® enables access to verified product information through Digital Product Passports—helping customers make confident, responsible purchasing decisions.
consumers.benefitsDescription: Consumers expect transparency, authenticity, and responsibility from the brands they support. Amid greenwashing claims and rising environmental awareness, trust has become the defining factor in purchasing decisions. Consumers want proof—clear, verifiable data that the products they buy are safe, sustainable, and ethically made. UseSafe empowers consumers to access that proof instantly. By connecting verified data from manufacturers, retailers, and regulatory authorities, UseSafe enables individuals to scan a product's Digital Product Passport (DPP) and view trusted information about its origin, materials, compliance, and environmental footprint. This transparency bridges the gap between brands and consumers, turning trust into an interactive experience. Beyond transparency, UseSafe helps consumers make smarter, more sustainable choices. By providing credible, accessible insights on safety, durability, and recyclability, UseSafe transforms product data into everyday guidance—helping people align their purchasing behavior with their values. With UseSafe, sustainability becomes personal, and every purchase becomes a step toward a more responsible future.

instantVerification.title: Instant Product Verification
instantVerification.description: Know exactly what you buy. With a single scan of a Digital Product Passport (DPP), consumers can access verified details on product origin, materials, and sustainability credentials—instantly and reliably.

safetyCompliance.title: Safety & Compliance Transparency
safetyCompliance.description: Feel confident about product safety. UseSafe® ensures consumers can view verified compliance data—covering chemical safety, material standards, and environmental certifications—before making a purchase.

environmentalImpact.title: Environmental Impact Awareness
environmentalImpact.description: See how your choices matter. UseSafe® displays clear sustainability metrics—carbon footprint, recyclability, reusability—so consumers understand each product's environmental impact.

repairability.title: Repairability & Product Lifecycle Data
repairability.description: Extend your product's life with confidence. UseSafe® provides guidance on product maintenance, repair options, and component availability—encouraging responsible consumption and reducing waste.

ethicalSourcing.title: Ethical & Transparent Sourcing
ethicalSourcing.description: Buy with purpose. Through UseSafe®, consumers gain visibility into supply chain ethics—labor practices, sourcing origins, and fair-trade compliance—promoting conscious purchasing decisions.

loyaltyTrust.title: Loyalty Through Trust

logistics.heroDescription: Digital product passports provide logistics operators and customs authorities with streamlined clearance processes, real-time compliance verification, and enhanced operational efficiency.
logistics.benefitsDescription: In a globalized economy, logistics and customs operators are under increasing pressure to ensure transparency, traceability, and compliance across complex supply chains. As international trade becomes more regulated under the EU Green Deal, ESPR, and evolving import/export standards, the ability to verify product origin, safety, and sustainability has become essential for efficient cross-border operations. Manual documentation and fragmented data systems can no longer meet the speed or precision required for modern compliance. UseSafe provides an integrated digital platform that connects logistics providers, freight forwarders, and customs authorities to a single, reliable source of verified product data. By linking manufacturers, importers, and distributors through Digital Product Passports (DPPs), UseSafe enables seamless data flow across the supply chain—reducing clearance delays, documentation errors, and non-compliance risks. Beyond efficiency, UseSafe transforms logistics into a driver of transparency and sustainability. With verified traceability, automated compliance validation, and real-time reporting, logistics and customs operators can demonstrate accountability, support sustainable trade initiatives, and reinforce trust among governments, partners, and consumers. UseSafe bridges the gap between compliance and performance—turning every shipment into a source of verified value.
